name: build-profiles help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:build-profiles. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Seed the plan
entries.text: A new profile's plan starts from the framework's seed and feature catalog instead of empty.

entries.title: Take off the list
entries.text: Removes the profile from the list. Its data stays on disk.

entries.title: Copy of
entries.text: Starts the new profile as a copy of another one.

entries.title: Use it right away
entries.text: Switches to the new profile as soon as it's made.

entries.title: Clean up builds
entries.text: Lists archived builds that really finished, and builds in a profile that no longer exists. One tap fixes each.

entries.title: Clean up builds
entries.text: Opens the cleanup list: archived builds that really finished, with a one-tap fix.

entries.title: Review cleanup
entries.text: Opens the list of builds the cleanup scan flagged, so you can fix them.

entries.title: Fix
entries.text: Gives this build the status it earned (complete or landed), or moves it to the base profile. Nothing is deleted.

entries.title: Fix all
entries.text: Fixes every build on the list that can be fixed. Builds marked "needs a look" are left alone.

entries.title: Scan again
entries.text: Checks the builds again. Changes nothing.
